reasons: calibration status is NOT_PROVIDED (needs one of ['PROVIDED'])
ood status is NOT_PROVIDED (needs one of ['DISABLED_BY_POLICY', 'PROVIDED'])
authenticity status is NOT_PROVIDED (needs one of ['EXCLUDED_BY_POLICY', 'PROVIDED'])

authenticity.reason: authenticity representation and label policy are model-owner decisions; the checkpoint has no authenticity head

calibration.reason: no approved calibration policy or independent calibration export is available

limitations: Advisory triage only: does not confirm a wildfire, a location or a time; every report still goes to a human.
Fire/smoke visual-presence classifier only. It is not an authenticity or provenance detector.
Trained on D-Fire (web/public images); no evaluation on citizen phone photos exists.
Smoke generalises poorly to a new source (held-out fixed-camera ROC-AUC about 0.71 for the seed-0 checkpoint).
Any false-negative bound is invalid under source shift (measured FNR 29% flames / 52% smoke on the held-out source).

ood.reason: LoRA-feature OOD bank not generated and no independent OOD evaluation approved

outputs.semantics: two independent (multi-label) RAW logits; probability = sigmoid(logit / temperature); NOT calibrated until a calibration is provided

preprocessing.source: open_clip pretrained cfg for ViT-B-16-quickgelu / openai
